clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Tenaron's Summons calls you to Aldrassil. After helping Gilshalan Windwalker with woodland dangers, you are asked to meet Tenaron Stormgrip high in the great tree. The call draws you from local troubles toward the spiritual afflictions touching Teldrassil.

Your work against the venomous spiders and corrupted wildlife in the glen has reached Tenaron Stormgrip. Gilshalan Windwalker tells you the elder has asked for your presence. Even night elves, with their long lives, know better than to keep an elder waiting atop Aldrassil.

Tenaron waits in Aldrassil's highest chamber, looking across Shadowglen's boughs. Meeting him brings you into wider concerns of stewardship, including the cleansing of Teldrassil's moonwells and the corruption spreading through the young World Tree's ecosystem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.
We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, friend. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
